name: Disney Streaming Mid-Tier
notes:
Please note that AS22604 is being slowly phased out. All new peering and connectivity should use [AS23344](https://www.peeringdb.com/asn/23344) when available.

AS22604 is being phased out in Argentina, Chile, and Colombia.
AS22604 will remain available for now in Brazil.

If you’re interested in peering with us in a market we currently operate in, please provide additional details via [this form](https://airtable.com/appiIOZp7X24pq14v/pagx3nOWeiDTwRMdt/form). Please send all peering requests via this form.
